author: Dana Reyes
text:
Hi Sam,
Kicking off the Northwind dispatch project. Scope per the signed SOW: (1) dispatch dashboard, (2) driver mobile app pilot, (3) migration of the 2025 shipment history.
We agree the dispatch dashboard will be handed over on 2026-03-20; Northwind signs off after the UAT week.
Migration target is end of March.
Dana Reyes, Project Manager, Acme Build

author: Sam Okafor
text:
Thanks Dana. For the mobile app pilot we need sign-off from our fleet safety lead before any driver uses it. Let's do the kickoff call on Wednesday.
Sam Okafor, Director of Operations, Northwind Freight

Meeting notes (AI note-taker). Kickoff call between Acme Build and Northwind Freight.
Priya Shah (Northwind fleet safety lead) said the pilot app must pass her safety checklist before rollout.
Dana Reyes said a first build of the driver app is planned for the week of the 16th.
Agreed: weekly status call every Friday.

author: Lee Tran
text: Dashboard charts are built, the data feed is still mocked.

author: Ferris
text: Weekly summary: dashboard on track, migration at risk. The client accepted the dashboard design.

author: Sam Okafor
text: Dana, we want the dashboard to also show live driver ETA. Can you add that before handover?

author: Dana Reyes
text: Adding live ETA is doable, but it moves the dashboard handover to 2026-03-27. Please confirm.

author: Sam Okafor
text: Confirmed: add live ETA, and a handover on 2026-03-27 is fine.

author: Lee Tran
text: Migration script ran on a sample of 10k shipments, 3 field mapping errors to fix.
Weekly status (AI notes). Dana reported that the client is very happy with the dashboard demo. Lee said the migration will slip to mid-April because of the mapping errors.

author: Dana Reyes
text: Priya, the first build of the driver app is on TestFlight for your safety review.

author: Priya Shah
text: I went through the safety checklist on the pilot app and it passes. You’ve got my sign-off for the pilot.

author: Sam Okafor
text: For the migration we only need the Q3 and Q4 2025 history, not the full year. Please plan for that.

author: Lee Tran
text: Live ETA feed is wired into the dashboard, UAT can start Monday.

author: Dana Reyes
text: Understood. New migration date: 2026-04-15, covering Q3 and Q4 2025 only.
